tag: WHAT COFFEE DOES PAST YOUR STOMACH

beats.text: Coffee **most days?** Your **gut** may have noticed.

beats.label: How they checked
beats.text: **61** healthy Danish adults logged every drink for **8 days.** Most swallowed a **sensor capsule.**
beats.note: Univ. of Copenhagen, Gut Microbiology, Nov 2026

beats.label: Small intestine
beats.text: Frequent coffee drinkers had a more **acidic** small intestine and more **diverse** gut bacteria.

beats.label: Colon
beats.text: More caffeine by-products in urine went with more **colon contractions,** the squeezes that move things **along.**

beats.label: Another clue
beats.text: A separate study of about **6,800** Japanese adults also tied coffee to gut patterns with **butyrate-making** bacteria.
beats.note: Nagata et al., Nature Medicine, Nov 2026

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Both **observational.** Small group, healthy Danes, and whether more acidity is **good or bad** isn't known yet.
Follow to see what your **morning cup** does after you **swallow** it.
